brief: A resort-town house in Petoskey: George Schantz's house, as photographed — see the photo for its massing and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: Petoskey's resort-town streets (the town's model) were built 1880-1930, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the George Schantz House and Store (Petoskey, 1900): a low cross-gabled cottage with a flat-roofed shop addition (its door and display window) on the corner, sage-green siding, skylights; a weathered picket fence on a low segmental-block wall with a garden; a fire hydrant

why.note: a house with its corner shop attached: the neighbourhood store
a picket fence on a low retaining wall
